test_title: PYST 39: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. No streak is a line.

II. Some lines are bands.

III. All bands are flashes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some flashes are streaks.

II. No flash is a line.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0c53c6f1491a80141fc53cb14754ed766837eec27c806b621277696a7df91ac.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some flashes are streaks → Does not follow (As no streak is a line, some lines are bands and all bands are flashes. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. No flash is a line → Does not follow (As some lines are bands and all bands are flashes. So, no direct relation is given between flash and line thus cannot be proved therefore it is definitely false)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (4)".
